about.title: About Me
about.content1: I'm a passionate full stack web developer with expertise in creating responsive and user-friendly web applications. With a strong foundation in both front-end and back-end technologies, I bring ideas to life through clean and efficient code.
about.content2: I believe in continuous learning and staying up-to-date with the latest industry trends to deliver the best solutions for my clients. When I'm not coding, you can find me exploring new technologies, contributing to open source projects, or sharing my knowledge with the developer community.
